title: 4 Day Private Camping Tour Tarangire Serengeti & Ngorongoro Crater
description: Experience an unforgettable 4-day private camping safari in Tanzania, exploring three of the country's most iconic wildlife destinations: Tarangire National Park, Serengeti National Park and the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. This adventure offers an opportunity to discover Tanzania's landscapes, diverse wildlife and authentic African wilderness within a short but rewarding safari. Explore Tarangire, famous for its giant elephant herds and ancient baobab trees, before continuing to the endless plains of Serengeti.

Discover the African Big Five and enjoy game drives in search of big cats, including lions, leopards and cheetahs. Depending on your travel season, you will also have the opportunity to follow the Great Wildebeest Migration as it moves across the Serengeti ecosystem. Your adventure concludes with a game drive inside Ngorongoro Crater, where you can search for elephants, buffaloes, lions, hippos and the endangered black rhino.
highlights: Three iconic destinations in four days: Tarangire, Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater
Tarangire's giant elephant herds and ancient baobab trees

Follow the Great Wildebeest Migration, depending on the season

Professional safari cook who prepares fresh meals throughout the camping nights
All essential camping equipment: sleeping tents, mattresses, sleeping bags, pillows, camping tables, chairs and cooking equipment

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport, or after being picked up from your hotel in Arusha or Moshi, you will meet your professional safari guide and begin your Tanzania wildlife adventure. After a short introduction and safari briefing, drive towards Tarangire National Park, one of the most beautiful wildlife destinations in Northern Tanzania.

Upon arrival, enjoy a game drive through the park, famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and beautiful savannah landscapes. Explore different wildlife areas in search of elephants, lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, buffaloes and numerous bird species. Your guide will share interesting information about the wildlife, animal behaviour and the unique ecosystem of Tarangire.

Enjoy a picnic lunch inside the park before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, exit the park and proceed to your campsite for dinner and overnight. Relax and enjoy your first authentic camping experience surrounded by the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Tarangire area to Serengeti National Park: explore the endless plains
itinerary.text:
After an early breakfast, depart for Serengeti National Park, travelling through the spectacular landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Along the way, enjoy views of the volcanic highlands, open grasslands and traditional Maasai communities. As you approach Serengeti, the scenery gradually transforms into endless golden plains dotted with acacia trees and rocky kopjes.

Upon entering Serengeti National Park, begin your game drive through one of Africa's most famous wildlife destinations. Explore the endless plains in search of the African Big Five and magnificent predators, particularly lions, leopards and cheetahs. You may also encounter elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, hyenas and many other species. Depending on your travel season, your guide will focus on areas with good opportunities to encounter the Great Wildebeest Migration.

Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive, taking advantage of the photography opportunities and wildlife encounters. In the late afternoon, proceed to your campsite for dinner and overnight, surrounded by the sounds of the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Serengeti National Park to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area
itinerary.text:
Wake up early and enjoy breakfast before another wildlife adventure in Serengeti. Depending on wildlife activity and your departure schedule, enjoy a morning game drive to explore different areas of the park, with another opportunity to search for lions, leopards, cheetahs and elephants.

Continue with a game drive as you gradually travel towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Depending on the season, your guide will select suitable wildlife-viewing areas along the route, with opportunities to observe migrating wildebeest and zebras. Enjoy a picnic lunch during the journey before continuing towards the Ngorongoro Highlands, where the landscape changes from open savannah plains to volcanic highlands.

Arrive at your campsite in the Ngorongoro area during the afternoon. Settle in, enjoy a freshly prepared dinner from your safari cook, and relax as you prepare for the following day's crater experience. An early night is recommended.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater game drive and departure
itinerary.text:
After an early breakfast, depart for the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, one of Africa's most remarkable natural wildlife destinations. Descend approximately 600 metres into the crater for a game drive across its beautiful landscape. The crater is home to an extraordinary concentration of wildlife, making it one of the best places in Tanzania to search for the African Big Five.

Explore the crater floor in search of lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos, hyenas and the endangered black rhino. Your guide will take you through different habitats, including open grasslands, woodland, swamps and lakes, with excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography. Enjoy a picnic lunch at a designated picnic site surrounded by the crater scenery.

In the afternoon, ascend the crater walls and begin your journey back to Arusha, Moshi, Arusha Airport or Kilimanjaro International Airport, depending on your departure arrangements. Your guide and driver will ensure a comfortable transfer according to your flight schedule, bringing your four-day private camping safari to a conclusion.

summary: A 4-day private camping safari through Tarangire, the Serengeti and Ngorongoro Crater: elephants, big cats and the crater floor, with your own guide, cook and camping equipment.
